Our person_id is bound to nm9946129; this name must NEVER be matched by string alone, and any future pass meeting a 'John Palmer' in a cast list should be queued, not merged.

TYPE_RESOLVED_BY_HOLDING: IMDb gives no type for 'The Photo That Changed Everything' or 'Emergency Reckoning: Brother's Fury'. Both are HELD in titles.csv - the first on reelshort, the second with NO platform row at all - and this database indexes nothing but verticals, so both are staged as credits. Same test used on Kirby Ellwood's ambiguous pair earlier today.
PLATFORM_GAIN_CANDIDATE: emergency-reckoning-brother-s-fury has no availability row, so it is one of the 262 titles completeness.py excludes entirely. This filmography gives it cast but not a platform.
CROSS_REFERENCE: He plays Ivan in 'Fall for My Ex's Mafia Dad'; Tim Stein, from another PDF in this batch, plays Kent Lippen in the same title.
